items.title: Automatic Ontology Construction Using LLMs as an External Layer of Memory, Verification, and Planning for Hybrid Intelligent Systems
items.title_zh: 将 LLM 作为外部记忆、验证与规划层的自动本体构建
items.summary: The paper presents a hybrid architecture that extends LLMs with an external ontological memory layer, automatically building and maintaining RDF/OWL knowledge graphs from documents, APIs and dialogue logs. At inference, vector retrieval is combined with graph reasoning and validated outputs flow through a generation-verification-correction pipeline; Tower of Hanoi experiments suggest ontology augmentation improves multi-step planning.

items.title: BODHI: Precise OS Kernel Specification Inference
items.title_zh: BODHI：精确的操作系统内核规约推断
items.summary: BODHI augments few-shot prompts with a structured C-to-Python translation guide covering 15 categories of domain-specific patterns, organized in a structured chain-of-thought style by separation of concerns. On OSV-Bench it improves all nine tested models by 11% to 32%, with Claude Opus 4.6 reaching 96.73% Pass@1 against a previously reported best of 55.10%.

items.title: Breaking MCP with Function Hijacking Attacks: Novel Threats for Function Calling and Agentic Models
items.title_zh: 函数劫持攻击攻破 MCP：函数调用与智能体模型的新型威胁
items.summary: The paper introduces a function hijacking attack that manipulates an agentic model's tool-selection process to force an attacker-chosen function, largely independent of context semantics. It reaches 62.5% to 81.9% attack success on held-out queries across four function-calling LLMs on BFCL and transfers across model sizes and families at 11.2% to 27.6% attack success.

items.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-27B：27B 稠密模型实现旗舰级编程能力
items.summary: Qwen introduced Qwen3.6-27B, a 27-billion-parameter dense model presented as reaching flagship-level coding performance. The announcement also lists broader Qwen capabilities including chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search and tool use.

items.title: Serialisation Strategy Matters: How FHIR Data Format Affects LLM Medication Reconciliation
items.title_zh: 序列化策略很重要：FHIR 数据格式如何影响 LLM 药物重整
items.summary: The study compares four FHIR serialisation strategies across five open-weight models on 200 synthetic patients and 4,000 inference runs. Clinical Narrative beats Raw JSON by up to 19 F1 points for models up to 8B, while Raw JSON is best at 70B; omission is the dominant failure mode, and smaller models plateau at roughly 7-10 concurrent active medications.

items.title: Using Machine Mental Imagery for Representing Common Ground in Situated Dialogue
items.title_zh: 用机器心理意象表示情境对话中的共同基础
items.summary: The paper identifies representational blur, where similar but distinct entities collapse into interchangeable descriptions once common ground must be kept beyond the immediate context window. Its active visual scaffolding framework incrementally turns dialogue state into a persistent visual history, and on the IndiRef benchmark visual scaffolding adds gains over full-dialog reasoning, with a hybrid multimodal setting performing best overall.

items.title: Co-Evolving LLM Decision and Skill Bank Agents for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.title_zh: 面向长时程任务的决策与技能库智能体协同进化
items.summary: COSPLAY co-evolves an LLM decision agent that retrieves skills from a learnable skill bank with an agent-managed pipeline that discovers, refines and updates reusable skills and their contracts from unlabeled rollouts. Across six game environments, an 8B base model improves average reward by over 25.1% against four frontier LLM baselines on single-player benchmarks while remaining competitive on multi-player social-reasoning games.

items.title: Cross-Session Threats in AI Agents: Benchmark, Evaluation, and Algorithms
items.title_zh: AI 智能体的跨会话威胁：基准、评估与算法
items.summary: The paper argues that AI-agent guardrails judge each message in isolation, letting an adversary spread a single attack across many sessions so that only the aggregate carries the payload. It introduces CSTM-Bench, with 26 executable attack taxonomies and two 54-scenario splits, and reports that a session-bound judge and a full-log correlator each lose roughly half their attack recall on the cross-session split, while a bounded-memory Coreset Memory Reader keeps its recall on both.

items.title: Beyond Pixels: Introspective and Interactive Grounding for Visualization Agents
items.title_zh: 超越像素：可视化智能体的内省式与交互式锚定
items.summary: IVG addresses the pixel-only bottleneck in which vision-language models treat interactive charts as static images and lose the structured specification that encodes exact values. Combining spec-grounded introspection with view-grounded interaction, it reaches the highest QA accuracy of 0.81 on the 500-figure iPlotBench, with a 6.7% gain on overlapping geometries.

items.title: Slot Machines: How LLMs Keep Track of Multiple Entities
items.title_zh: 老虎机：LLM 如何追踪多个实体
items.summary: Using multi-slot probing, the authors separate a token's residual stream into largely orthogonal current-entity and prior-entity slots. The prior-entity slot supports relational inferences such as entity-level induction and conflict detection, but only the current-entity slot is used for explicit factual retrieval; open-weight models perform near chance on syntax that forces two subject-verb-object bindings onto one token, while recent frontier models can parse it.

items.title: Speeding up agentic workflows with WebSockets in the Responses API
items.title_zh: 利用 Responses API 中的 WebSocket 加速智能体工作流
items.summary: OpenAI details the Codex agent loop and explains how WebSockets and connection-scoped caching reduce API overhead and improve model latency for agentic workflows.

items.title: Introducing workspace agents in ChatGPT
items.title_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中引入工作区智能体
items.summary: OpenAI introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT: Codex-powered agents that automate complex workflows, run in the cloud and help teams scale work across tools securely.
